name: Config Refresh
description: Windows MDM settings in the Config Refresh category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Config refresh
properties.description: This node determines whether or not a periodic settings refresh for MDM policies will occur.

properties.name: Provider ID
properties.description: This node contains the URI-encoded value of the bootstrapped device management account’s Provider ID. Scope is dynamic. This value is set and controlled by the MDM server. As a best practice, use text that doesn’t require XML/URI escaping.

properties.name: Refresh cadence
properties.description: This node determines the number of minutes between refreshes.
